acceptance_criteria: All 30 digest-bound work units complete, including streaming exact quench lanes, TDVP ring refinements, and one independent Fig. 2(a) symmetry block per declared candidate size.
Checkpoint/resume retains only the current Krylov state and scalar observables; aggregation refuses missing or stale lanes.
Small-system streaming/batched parity is <=2e-12; candidate-size quench norm and energy drift are each <=1e-8.
TDVP periods, leakages, ring convergence, thermal relaxation, Z2 revival envelopes, Hamiltonian Hermiticity, and r-statistics gates in config/paper_scale.json all pass.
The missing Fig. 2(a) plotted L sequence remains parameter_ambiguity even after candidate-size execution; the campaign cannot promote it to paper_exact.
The manifest records no author code, author arrays, digitized curves, source pixels, or PDF pixels as numerical inputs.
Stable differences follow protocol-v2 attribution; paper_error_candidate requires paper-exact inputs, convergence, two independent cross-checks, source pinpoint, and fresh review.
The blocked Hamiltonian is exactly equivalent to the periodic L=30 PXP Hamiltonian on the constrained Hilbert space.
Six deterministic initial-state/refinement lanes complete with digest-bound checkpoints and the final unsharded --resume merge writes the aggregate arrays.
The run covers six-site entropy through t*Omega=100 and one-site entropy through t*Omega=120 for both the all-zero and Z2 initial states.
Norm, energy, constrained-subspace, entropy-bound, time-step-refinement, bond-refinement and generic-versus-scarred feature criteria in the paper-scale config all pass.
Stable differences are first classified as reproduction_defect, parameter_ambiguity, insufficient_compute or inconclusive; paper_error_candidate requires all five protocol-v2 gates.
The manifest records no author code, author arrays, digitized curves, source pixels or PDF pixels as numerical inputs.
